question.text: Under SEBI regulations applicable to mutual fund distributors, which of the following disclosures is required?

answer.text: ARN/RIA/EUIN details on the application form, and all trail or other commissions for competing schemes recommended to the investor

explanation.text: The Logic: Mutual fund application forms for regular plans require the ARN/RIA and EUIN details of the intermediary, and distributors must disclose all trail and other commissions for the competing schemes they recommend to investors. The Trap: Distributors are not required to share personal financial data such as bank account numbers, Aadhaar, or income with investors; the regulatory disclosure focuses on intermediary identification and commission information on recommended competing schemes. Note: These two requirements are separate: the intermediary identification appears on the application form, while the commission comparison is provided when recommending competing schemes.
